subtheme: Looks incomplete but is fully specified (shorthand defined vs undefined)
what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/ambiguity/spec.md, tasks/ambiguity/dev.json and the checker code in lab/core.py
Wrote 21 single-mode tasks using the round-3 two-way format block verbatim, built by a Python script
Shuffled task order with a fixed seed so ASK and ANSWER cases do not alternate
verification: Every expected ANSWER value (products, sums, table lookups, rule branches, HH:MM end times) is computed by Python expressions in the generator script, not typed by hand
Reference and negative of every task scored with lab/core.score_episode: reference passes, negative fails

Each ASK task additionally tested with 2 alternative well-formed questions naming the gap (must pass), 2 questions about a stated fact or restating the task (must fail), and an ask-plus-answer reply (must fail)
Each ANSWER task tested that a generic ASK reply fails
notes: tags.expected (ANSWER or ASK) is free metadata added to each task

Difficulty labels follow the spec's guidance and are not measured: easy = 7 ANSWER with a plainly stated definition; medium = 2 indirect ANSWER + 5 ASK where required fields are listed or the note visibly covers another item; hard = 2 ANSWER with two-step or two-clause definitions + 5 ASK with a tempting distractor value
